title: Verifying An Alien Dictionary
summary: Check whether the words are in nondecreasing dictionary order under the alphabet given by order.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100 words of 1–20 lowercase English letters. order is a permutation of the 26 lowercase English letters.
contractDetails.output-checking: Use the supplied alphabet permutation for lexicographic comparisons, including prefix ordering.

statement: Check whether the words are in nondecreasing dictionary order under the alphabet given by order. At the first differing character, use its position in order. If one word is a prefix of another, the shorter word belongs first.

examples.explanation: z precedes a in the reversed alphabet.
The shorter prefix must come first.
Both adjacent pairs are ordered correctly.

constraints: 1–100 words of 1–20 lowercase English letters. order is a permutation of the 26 lowercase English letters.
hints: Conceptual: Dictionary comparison only needs the first differing character.
Directional: Map each letter to its rank in the supplied alphabet.
Implementation: Compare adjacent words, handling the shorter-prefix rule when their shared portion is identical.
complexityAnalysis: O(total word length + 26) time and O(26) auxiliary space.
